answer: Treat each new agent like a relic dug from a single ridge: valued only for what it uniquely carries. Every identity locks a bond that vests over 100 epochs, and a collusion detector compares answer timing, grading votes and attestation partners. When two identities co-move beyond chance, both bonds are slashed together. A farm cannot share one bond across fakes, and running fakes in parallel makes them correlate, so each extra fake adds a full bond plus a higher chance of losing all of them. Bulk-bought identities arrive hollow, with no independent history to hide behind.
